name: Axioma
fix_description: Add a time-based or admin-controlled close mechanism to buyToken(). The presale should be disabled once the token is live on DEX, preventing arbitrage between presale price and market price.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short two-step arbitrage-style exploit: flash-loan WBNB, buy underpriced presale tokens, then immediately dump them on PancakeSwap for profit. It relies on a simple pricing discrepancy rather than complex protocol internals, and the PoC is concise with minimal contract interaction.
